title: the install walk with real model servers on the bench host, a rehearsal box only
note: basis 'shown' for H89-01: the installer was run with stand-ins for docker and nvidia-smi, master's and this branch's, byte-identical; nothing ran on a card or under Docker.

findings.claim: an explicit --gpu <profile> is never compared with the card on master: install.sh --gpu rtxpro6000 on a card of another model (a whole B200) with a driver at the minimum passes the profile step, and the record step too (tools/serving_config.py measured compares the record's card with the profile's name, not with this host's card); only the driver and compute-capability checks stand

the boot start (deploy/systemd/trialbox.service ExecStartPre deploy/settings_guard.sh) does not run the rehearsal start guard: a rehearsal box whose deploy/.env TB_ENV is edited to PRODUCTION by hand starts at the next boot (doctor FAILs it); settings_guard.sh calling python3 -m tools.rehearsal_real start --deploy would close it
a re-run of the install on a running real-servers rehearsal box is refused by the card's free-memory check (its own model servers hold the card): stop the stack before a re-run

the console's banner says VALIDATION REHEARSAL on a real-servers rehearsal box, not the words 'rehearsal: driver below the minimum, not this profile's card, not valid for a site': services/console/app.py environment_banner reads TB_REHEARSAL only, and a change there is the console's lane's

the rehearsal mark deploy/site/rehearsal.json is checked for existing only, not for its content, owner or mode (as on master): forging it needs root on a DEV, TEST or VALIDATION box (with TB_REHEARSAL=1 on VALIDATION); a PRODUCTION box refuses it

with the pinned+libs form the probe's recorded LD_LIBRARY_PATH replaces the image's own value in the model servers instead of being put in front of it (the probe ran it as a shell prefix); to be checked on the bench
